WITH DocInfo AS (
  SELECT
    d.doc_id,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
  FROM docs d

SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  doc.pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,

  td.target_type

JOIN activities a

JOIN assays ass

JOIN molecule_dictionary md

JOIN compound_structures cs
  ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN DocInfo doc
  ON a.doc_id = doc.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741186'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
